documents.content: HTTP 200 on an order read means the request succeeded, not that the order completed. Callback is emitted only after COMPLETED. A PROCESSING order does not prove a callback failure. Query current order state before drawing a root cause.
documents.query: 异步订单接口 200 202 契约 回调触发 完成语义
documents.title: Order lifecycle and callback trigger

result.reason: 用户明确询问 200 与 202 的契约，且当前证据为空；需先确定契约语义，才能区分“未到回调时点”与投递/处理异常。

Order is already confirmed COMPLETED at version 2, so lifecycle is no longer the ambiguity. I need the method for correlating delivery transport acknowledgement with receiver processing before diagnosing the missing notification.

skill.content: Check the bound callback delivery record, correlate order version and event ID. FAILED/503 suggests a delivery failure. ACKNOWLEDGED/202 requires receiver processing verification for the same event. QUEUED does not mean processed. Use query retrieval for the current integration contract if uncertain. Never resend or modify permissions.

model_traces.assistant_text: 我先检索接入知识，明确该异步订单接口返回 200 与 202 的约定，以及回调何时才算完成；目前还缺订单生命周期、投递确认和接收方处理事实。

model_traces.assistant_text: 本次排查从订单状态开始，因为接口返回 HTTP 200 不能证明订单已完成，也不能证明尚未到回调触发时间。

args.reason: HTTP 200 on the order read does not prove lifecycle completion; the current order version and status determine whether a callback was even due yet.

args.name: callback-delivery-triage
args.reason: Order is already confirmed COMPLETED at version 2, so lifecycle is no longer the ambiguity. I need the method for correlating delivery transport acknowledgement with receiver processing before diagnosing the missing notification.

model_traces.assistant_text: 订单当前已为 `COMPLETED`（order_version 2），但订单读取成功不等于回调已送达。现有事实缺少针对该版本的投递事件及其实际传输确认/失败结果，因此下一步读取当前回调投递记录，先确认是否发出、是否被接收端确认。

args.reason: 订单已 COMPLETED 且版本为 2；需读取绑定的当前回调投递事件、订单版本关联及实际 HTTP 确认/失败结果，以判断下游未收到通知是否源于投递阶段。

Order is COMPLETED (v2) and the bound delivery event is ACKNOWLEDGED with HTTP 202 at the transport layer for the same order version. A 202 acknowledgement only proves receipt, not completed processing, so the remaining gap is whether the receiver actually processed event-b61a5c9a… — this determines whether the missing downstream notification is a delivery fault or a receiver-side processing fault.
